criteria.requirement: Repair default backoff/giveup logging for functools.partial and callable instances without __name__. Unwrap nested partials to a safe function name when available, otherwise use a stable type name; never call repr or expose bound arguments. Logs must not replace real return values or original exceptions with AttributeError. Preserve existing functions/methods, logger=None, levels and both predicate/exception modes without changing target call counts.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
